prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. High-fidelity Palla native organizer UX proposal, THREE equally sized tall portrait app screens side by side with legible English text, no physical device frames or browser. Small outside board labels '4 — Review & publish', '5 — Edit a session', '6 — Cancel safely'. Reference images carry established Palla light-only palette, Hanken Grotesk type, rounded medium fields and task hierarchy ONLY. Do not copy their screen content. Pale lavender #fbf8ff, white panels, dark ink #1a1b22, olive #536600, lime #d4ff00 buttons, pale selection #f7ffd5, thin subtle borders #e3e1ec. Native status bar and home indicator, generous margins, readable 16-unit body, 48-unit targets. No bottom tabs on any of these stack/editor/confirmation screens. Illustrative data.
Screen1: Back, 'Create session', Close header. Small step '3 of 3 · Review'. Heading 'Ready to publish?' One quiet white summary with title 'Tuesday social padel', 'Palermo Padel · Court 2', 'Every Tuesday · 19:00–20:30', 'Oct 20–Nov 17, 2026 · 5 sessions', 'Buenos Aires time'. Separate small section 'Players' with '7ma–6ta · 8 places', 'ARS 12,000 per player', 'Payment outside Palla'. Section 'Before the session' with 'Registration closes 2 hours before', 'Players can cancel until 24 hours before'. Quiet checkbox checked 'I’ve arranged the court with the club.' Bottom secondary 'Save draft' and lime full button 'Publish 5 sessions'. The information confirms both session details and recurrence scope without pretending court reservation is handled.
Screen2: Back left, 'Edit session' header. Heading 'Tuesday social padel'. Smaller 'Tue, Oct 20 · 6 players registered'. 'Apply changes to' two stacked native radio choices, 'Only this session' selected with pale lime small fill, 'This and future sessions' unselected with helper '5 sessions from Oct 20'. Editable field Start value '19:30' End value '21:00' in two columns; Club 'Palermo Padel'; Capacity numeric value '8'; Price per player 'ARS 12,000'. Quiet informational block 'Time changes affect 6 registered players. They’ll be notified after you save.' Footer lime full-width 'Save changes'. Below small danger-text link 'Cancel session' separated from primary save, no trash icon next to publish, no bottomtabs.
Screen3: a native bottom confirmation sheet over dimmed session details with dark scrim, not an alert dialog. Visible underlying title 'Tuesday social padel', 'Tue, Oct 20 · 19:00–20:30', '6 / 8 players'. Sheet contains drag handle, heading 'Cancel this session?', explanatory copy '6 registered players will be notified. The session will remain in your history.' Scope selector two clean radio rows 'Only Tuesday, Oct 20' selected / 'This and future sessions' unselected. Optional text field 'Reason for players' value 'The club is unavailable.' Two generous stacked buttons: solid deep red #ba1a1a white text 'Cancel session'; neutral white bordered 'Keep session'. No lime destructive button, no payment/refund promise. At bottom outside board a separate compact note 'Drafts use a Delete draft confirmation. Published sessions are cancelled to preserve attendance history.' Board footnote 'Design proposal · Illustrative data'. Keep all wording clean and coherent, no tiny unreadable panels.
approval: User approved implementation October 13, 2026, with visual refinement deferred.
